key_insight: AI can unify noisy, multimodal stability data to diagnose, explain, predict, and mitigate degradation in 3D all-inorganic perovskites like CsPbX3.
engineering_relevance: This framework supports more reliable design of stable perovskite solar cells, detectors, and LEDs by linking mechanism discovery to practical durability strategies.
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes that current studies are limited by multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertain quantification, which AI is positioned to address.
watch_item: Transferability remains a concern because performance can depend strongly on data quality, benchmark design, and inconsistent experimental protocols.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
